description: Updates the status of a single Financial Period, scoped to the company.

id.description: Unique identifier of the financial period. Use as the {id} path parameter to update a single period's status via PATCH /financial_periods/periods/{id}.

group_name.description: Name of the period group this period belongs to (e.g. "FY 2026"). Use as the {group_name} path parameter to update or delete the whole group.

name.description: Display name of the individual period within the group (e.g. "Q1 2026").

start_date.description: First day of the period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

end_date.description: Last day of the period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the period was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the period was last updated (ISO 8601).

status.description: New lifecycle status to apply to this period.
